    {

When `pluck()` runs on a chaperoned relationship, the `afterQuery` callback receives scalar values (e.g. ints) instead of models, and the unconditional call to `applyInverseRelationToModel(Model $model, ...)` threw a `TypeError`. Non-model results are now skipped, so:

- `$Post->Comments()->pluck('id')` returns `[1, 2]` instead of a `TypeError`
- `get()` still chaperones models back to the parent (all 67 existing inverse-relation tests pass, plus 431 Builder/HasMany/HasOne/Model/Collection tests)
